items.reason: The Meet fallback dereferences an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar when destinations are null or empty, throwing instead of falling back to Cal Video.
Video references lose result.credentialId, preventing cancellation from finding the credential needed to delete the meeting.
Office365 creation selects the first destination instead of the current credential's destination. The additional provider guidance includes the same existing problem.
Google update/delete fallback searches for an externalId equal to the absent externalCalendarId, losing the configured destination.
Recurring cancellation repeatedly deletes the organizer's first calendar reference while leaving secondary hosts' events untouched.
The inverted billing condition omits slug when billing is disabled, leaving the organization with neither slug nor requestedSlug.
Office365 uses the first host's destination with another host's credential; the mixed-provider example is another consequence of the same selection bug.
Office365 always selects destinationCalendar[0] instead of matching the credential supplied for the current host.
The reference mapping discards credentialId for video results, losing the credential association needed by subsequent lifecycle operations.
The Meet fallback reads .integration from an undefined first destination when the destination array is null or empty.
Office365 targets the first destination using a secondary host's token. The inconsistent saved reference is an additional consequence of that same destination-selection bug.
Office365 selects the organizer's destination for secondary hosts instead of selecting by the supplied credentialId.
A null destination leaves mainHostDestinationCalendar undefined, and its unguarded integration access crashes the Meet fallback.
Office365 always uses the first destination despite being called separately with each collective host's credential.
The Google update/delete fallback compares destination externalId against an already-falsy externalCalendarId, failing to recover the configured calendar.
The optional push drops collective members' destinations when the organizer's destinationCalendar is initialized to null.
